description: Ministry of Women Child Affairs and Social Empowerment - Children and Young Persons (Amendment) Act No. 39 of 2022 Order Under Subsection (2) of Section 1
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal order that brings the Children and Young Persons (Amendment) Act, No. 39 of 2022 into operation. It is a statutory instrument made under the authority of an existing Act, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory matters and legal notices. While it names a minister, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or make any government personnel/structure changes, so it does not qualify for government Types 1-3.
